name: sg-vault-client
description: Browser-based vault access using Web Crypto API. v1.2.2 adds importReadKey() for the embed stack.

added: importReadKey(readKeyBase64Url) — import a base64url-encoded 32-byte AES-256-GCM key directly
readObject(apiBaseUrl, vaultId, objectId, cryptoKey) — fetch+decrypt using direct parameters (embed stack API)
